# External documents

`prd-forge-viewer-prd.pdf` is an export of the PRD set, version 0.6.0. The sponsor
approved version 0.5.0 on 2026-10-27. Versions 0.5.1 and 0.6.0 wait for approval. It holds all 18 documents.

The source is `docs/prd/prd-forge-viewer/`. If the PRD changes, export it again
and copy the new PDF to this folder.
